definition_zh: 农业的；农学的；耕种的；农田的
definition_en: relating to farming, to the science of farming, or to land used for growing crops
core_image: 犁铧翻开泥土，一条直直的垄沟伸向远处
scene: 天还没亮，收割机就开进了麦田，车灯照着一行行麦茬。The village depends on agricultural work that begins before sunrise.
sceneCN: 这里 agricultural 是「农业的」（第 1 个义项：与耕作、畜牧相关的）；句意为这个村子依靠天不亮就开始的农活为生。

pos.zh: 形容词：农业的；农学的；耕种的

derivatives.zh: 去掉形容词后缀得到的基础名词，义为「农业；农学」
由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「在农业方面」
由本词加后缀 -ist 构成，义为「农学家；务农者」

senses.title: Relating to farming
senses.definition: relating to the growing of crops and the raising of animals for food
senses.definitionCN: 与种植作物、饲养食用动物相关的
senses.example: The village depends on agricultural work that begins before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子依靠天不亮就开始的农活为生。
senses.why: The adjective simply attaches the whole activity of farming to any noun that follows it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是把耕作这一整件事附加到它后面的名词上。

senses.title: Relating to the science of farming
senses.definition: relating to the academic study of farming methods and soils
senses.definitionCN: 与农作方法与土壤的学术研究相关的
senses.example: She is doing agricultural research on drought-resistant wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 她在做抗旱小麦的农业研究。
senses.why: Once farming becomes a subject taught in universities, its adjective also names the research side.
senses.whyCN: 一旦耕作成为大学里讲授的学科，这个形容词也用来指研究的那一面。

senses.title: Involving cultivation of the soil
senses.definition: involving the actual tilling and working of land
senses.definitionCN: 涉及实际翻耕与打理土地的
senses.example: Most families here have an agricultural life rather than an industrial one.
senses.exampleCN: 这里多数家庭过的是务农生活，而不是工业生活。
senses.why: Latina cultura meant tending, and the adjective keeps that hands-in-the-soil sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 cultura 意为「照料」，这个形容词保留了双手沾泥的那层意思。

senses.title: Of land used for crops
senses.definition: describing land or areas set aside for crops or pasture
senses.definitionCN: 描述专门用于种植或放牧的土地与区域
senses.example: Half of the region is agricultural land and the rest is forest.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区一半是农田，其余是森林。
senses.why: Land itself can be labelled by what it is used for, so the adjective moves from activity to territory.
senses.whyCN: 土地本身可以按用途被命名，于是这个形容词从活动转到了地界。

intro.en: Agricultural is an English adjective on agriculture, whose two Latin halves mean field and tending.
intro.cn: agricultural 是在 agriculture 之上构成的英语形容词，而后者的两个拉丁成分意为「田地」与「照料」。

items.en: Ager meant a field or open land, and it is the first half of the word.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ager 意为「田地、开阔地」，是这个词的前半。

items.en: Cultura meant tending, cultivation, and later also the training of mind; here it keeps the farming sense.
items.cn: cultura 意为「照料、耕作」，后来也指心智的培养；在此保留农耕义。

items.en: The compound agricultura named the cultivation of fields, and English took it as agriculture in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 复合词 agricultura 指田地的耕作，英语十六世纪借入为 agriculture。

items.en: The adjective agricultural was formed with -al as farming became a subject of policy and science. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 随着农业成为政策与科学研究的对象，形容词 agricultural 由 -al 构成。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The adjective now covers farming as work, as science, and as a use of land.
items.cn: 如今这个形容词覆盖农业作为劳动、作为科学，以及作为土地用途三个方面。

note.en: The look-alike group is the agriculture family; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for country life and cultivation.
note.cn: 形近组是 agriculture 词族；近义组收描述乡村生活与耕作的其他形容词。

entries.definition: The noun for farming and for the science that studies it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农业、农学」，是本词的基础形式。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning in farming terms or from a farming point of view.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在农业方面」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: A person who studies or practises farming as a profession.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农学家、务农者」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: Relating to land ownership and rural society, rather than to farming technique.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「土地的、农耕社会的」，侧重土地制度而非耕作技术。

entries.definition: Relating to the countryside, including villages and life outside cities.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「乡村的」，涵盖村庄与城市之外的生活。

entries.definition: The everyday noun and modifier for the work of growing crops and keeping animals.
entries.definitionCN: 名词兼修饰语，义为「务农、耕作」，是最日常的说法。

entries.definition: Relating to garden cultivation, a narrower field than agriculture.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「园艺的」，范围比农业更窄，专指园圃栽培。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Latin halves of the word and the phrases it appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用这个词的两个拉丁成分，以及它实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Ager is a field and cultura is tending, so agricultural means field-tending.
normal.cn: ager 是田地，cultura 是照料，所以 agricultural 就是「照料田地」。

normal.en: Agriculture is the noun; agricultural is what you call anything that belongs to it.
normal.cn: agriculture 是名词；凡属于它的事物，就用 agricultural 来形容。

normal.en: Agricultural land is land earmarked for crops or pasture.
normal.cn: agricultural land 是划给作物或牧场的土地。

normal.en: Agricultural science is the university side of the same activity.
normal.cn: agricultural science 是同一件事在大学里的那一面。

normal.en: Cultura also gives culture, which is the tending of minds instead of fields.
normal.cn: cultura 还生出 culture，那是照料心智而非田地。

abstract.en: Picture a plough blade opening the soil and a straight furrow running to the horizon.
abstract.cn: 想象犁铧翻开泥土，一条笔直的垄沟伸向天边。

abstract.en: Follow the furrow and it passes a laboratory, a policy office, and a land register.
abstract.cn: 沿着这条垄沟走，它会经过一间实验室、一个政策办公室和一本土地登记册。

abstract.en: The same line is work, study and territory at once.
abstract.cn: 同一条线同时是劳动、学问与地界。

examples.en: The village depends on agricultural work that begins before sunrise.
examples.cn: 这个村子依靠天不亮就开始的农活为生。

examples.en: Half of the region is agricultural land and the rest is forest.
examples.cn: 这个地区一半是农田，其余是森林。

examples.en: She is doing agricultural research on drought-resistant wheat.
examples.cn: 她在做抗旱小麦的农业研究。

root: 拉丁语 ager「田地」加 cultura「照料、耕作」构成 agricultura「耕作田地」，英语十六世纪借入为 agriculture，十八世纪再加形容词后缀 -al 构成 agricultural；cultura 也是 culture 的来源。

sensesIntro.en: The four senses apply one adjective to four sides of the same activity: the work itself, the science of it, the labour of tilling, and the land it uses.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项把同一个形容词用到同一件事的四个侧面：农活本身、研究它的学问、翻土劳作，以及它所占的土地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a plough blade opens the soil and a straight furrow runs towards the horizon.
core.cn: 核心意象：犁铧翻开泥土，一条笔直的垄沟伸向天边。

branches.en: THE WORK: the adjective names everything that belongs to growing crops and keeping animals.
branches.cn: 劳动线：这个形容词指一切与种植和饲养相关的事物。

branches.en: THE STUDY: the same activity becomes a university subject with its own research.
branches.cn: 学问线：同一件事变成大学里的一门学科，拥有自己的研究。

branches.en: THE HANDS: cultura keeps the sense of actual tending, hands in the soil.
branches.cn: 双手线：cultura 保留实际照料的意思，双手沾着泥土。

branches.en: THE GROUND: land is labelled by the use it is put to.
branches.cn: 土地线：土地按用途被命名。

branches.en: THE BASE: both rest on the same Latin pair, field plus tending.
branches.cn: 根基线：两者都建立在同一对拉丁成分上，即田地加照料。

intro.en: Agricultural combines a Latin compound noun with the English adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: agricultural 把拉丁复合名词与英语形容词后缀 -al 组合在一起。

latinIntro.en: Ager, cultura and agricultura are all recorded, so nothing in this entry is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: ager、cultura 与 agricultura 均有记录，本条目的成分都不是重构形式。

items.example: Ager is the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: ager 是这个复合词的前半。

items.example: Cultura also gives the English word culture.
items.exampleCN: cultura 还生出英语词 culture。

items.example: English borrowed it as agriculture.
It forms agricultural.
It forms agriculturally.
It forms agriculturalist.
It appears in agronomy and agrochemical.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 agronomy 与 agrochemical 中。

items.example: The map marks all agricultural land in green.
items.exampleCN: 地图把农业用地都标成绿色。

definition_zh: 农业；农学；耕作；农业产业
definition_en: the practice or science of farming, including the growing of crops and the raising of animals
core_image: 同一块田里，春天撒种，秋天堆起粮垛
scene: 清晨的田埂上有人赶着牛下地，远处是成片的稻田。Her family has lived by agriculture for four generations.
sceneCN: 这里 agriculture 是「农业、耕作」（第 1 个义项：种植与饲养这一行当）；句意为她家四代人都靠务农为生。

pos.zh: 名词：农业；农学；耕作

senses.title: The practice of farming
senses.definition: the work of growing crops and raising animals for food and other products
senses.definitionCN: 种植作物、饲养动物以获取食物及其他产品的工作
senses.example: Her family has lived by agriculture for four generations.
senses.exampleCN: 她家四代人都靠务农为生。
senses.why: The Latin halves mean field and tending, so the compound names the whole activity of working land.
senses.whyCN: 两个拉丁成分意为「田地」与「照料」，这个复合词因此指打理土地的一整套活动。

senses.title: The science that studies farming
senses.definition: the academic study of soils, crops, and animal husbandry
senses.definitionCN: 研究土壤、作物与畜牧的学科
senses.example: He studied agriculture at a college outside the city.
senses.exampleCN: 他在城外一所学院学习农学。
senses.why: Any practice detailed enough to be taught becomes a science, and keeps its old name.
senses.whyCN: 任何精细到可以教授的实践都会成为一门学科，并沿用原来的名字。

senses.title: The activity of tilling land
senses.definition: the day-to-day labour of preparing soil, sowing, and harvesting
senses.definitionCN: 整地、播种与收获这些日常劳动
senses.example: Agriculture here still depends on rain and on hand tools.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的耕作仍依赖雨水和手工工具。
senses.why: Cultura means tending, and this sense keeps the work at the level of hands and seasons.
senses.whyCN: cultura 意为照料，这个义项把工作保持在双手与季节的层面。

senses.title: The farming sector of an economy
senses.definition: the branch of a national economy that produces food and raw materials from the land
senses.definitionCN: 国民经济中以土地生产食物与原料的部门
senses.example: Agriculture employs a third of the workforce in that province.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个省，农业雇用了三分之一的劳动力。
senses.why: Statistics needed a name for a whole sector, and used the activity word for the industry.
senses.whyCN: 统计需要一个名称来指整个部门，于是用这项活动的词来指这个产业。

intro.en: Agriculture is a Latin compound of field and tending, borrowed whole into English in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: agriculture 是拉丁语「田地」与「照料」的复合词，十六世纪整词借入英语。

items.en: Ager meant field or open land, and the same root gives the prefix agro- in modern terms.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ager 意为「田地、开阔地」，同一词根在现代术语中给出前缀 agro-。

items.en: Cultura meant tending and cultivation, and it also grew into the modern word culture.
items.cn: cultura 意为「照料、耕作」，并进一步发展为现代词 culture。

items.en: The compound named the cultivation of fields, and Roman writers used it for farming in general.
items.cn: 这个复合词指田地的耕作，罗马作家用它泛指农耕。

items.en: English borrowed agriculture in the sixteenth century, at first as a learned word for the art of farming. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 agriculture，最初是学术用语，指农耕之术。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The word widened from the art of farming to the science and to a whole sector of the economy.
items.cn: 这个词从农耕之术扩展为农学，再扩展为整个经济部门。

note.en: The look-alike group is the agriculture family; the near-meaning group gathers words for farming and land work.
note.cn: 形近组是 agriculture 词族；近义组收表示农耕与土地劳作的词。

entries.definition: The adjective describing anything that belongs to farming.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「农业的」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning from a farming point of view.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在农业方面」，由形容词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: A person who works in or studies farming.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农学家、务农者」，由形容词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The everyday word for the same activity, with no learned tone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「务农、耕作」，是同一件事最日常的说法，不带学术色彩。

entries.definition: The act of preparing land and growing crops, with stress on the tending.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「耕作、栽培」，侧重对土地的照料。

entries.definition: The careful management of land and animals, often in older or formal use.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农牧管理」，指对土地与牲畜的精心经营，多见于较早或正式的文字。

entries.definition: The branch of agricultural science that deals with soils and crop production.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农艺学」，是农业科学中研究土壤与作物生产的分支。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Latin halves and the phrases agriculture appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用两个拉丁成分，以及 agriculture 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Ager plus cultura means field tending, which is exactly what farming is.
normal.cn: ager 加 cultura 意为「照料田地」，这正是务农在做的事。

normal.en: Cultura is also the source of culture, so both words are about careful tending.
normal.cn: cultura 也是 culture 的来源，两个词都关涉精心照料。

normal.en: Agriculture as a school subject is the same word with a textbook.
normal.cn: 作为学校科目的 agriculture，是同一个词配上一本教科书。

normal.en: The ministry of agriculture is the government office for the whole sector.
normal.cn: ministry of agriculture 是主管整个农业部门的政府机关。

normal.en: Intensive agriculture packs more labour and input into the same field.
normal.cn: intensive agriculture 指在同一块田里投入更多劳动与物资。

abstract.en: Picture one field in spring with seeds going in, and the same field in autumn with grain stacked high.
abstract.cn: 想象同一块田，春天把种子撒下去，秋天粮垛堆得很高。

abstract.en: The field also becomes a classroom, a budget line, and a map coloured green.
abstract.cn: 这块田还会变成一间教室、一行预算，以及地图上涂成绿色的一片。

abstract.en: Every one of those views is still the same tended ground.
abstract.cn: 上面每一种看法，说的仍是同一片被照料的地。

examples.en: Her family has lived by agriculture for four generations.
examples.cn: 她家四代人都靠务农为生。

examples.en: He studied agriculture at a college outside the city.
examples.cn: 他在城外一所学院学习农学。

examples.en: Agriculture employs a third of the workforce in that province.
examples.cn: 在那个省，农业雇用了三分之一的劳动力。

root: 拉丁语 ager「田地」加 cultura「照料、耕作」构成 agricultura「耕作田地」，十六世纪整词借入英语为 agriculture；cultura 同时是 culture 的来源，词义由农耕之术扩展为农学与农业产业。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses follow the same ground: as work, as a subject of study, as daily labour, and as a sector of the economy.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项围绕同一块地：它是劳动、是学科、是日常活计，也是一个经济部门。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one field is sown in spring and stacked with grain in autumn.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一块田春天播种，秋天堆满粮食。

branches.en: THE PRACTICE: the compound names the whole craft of working land.
branches.cn: 行当线：这个复合词指打理土地的一整套手艺。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM: the craft becomes teachable and turns into a science.
branches.cn: 课堂线：这门手艺变得可教，于是成为一门学科。

branches.en: THE SEASONS: the daily labour of soil, seed, and harvest stays close to the hands.
branches.cn: 季节线：整地、下种、收获这些日常劳动始终贴近双手。

branches.en: THE ECONOMY: statistics treat the same activity as a whole branch of production.
branches.cn: 经济线：统计把同一项活动当作整个生产部门。

branches.en: THE ROOT: both the craft and the labour rest on field plus tending.
branches.cn: 词根线：行当与劳作都建立在「田地加照料」上。

intro.en: Agriculture is a Latin compound taken whole; English later builds its adjective and adverbs from it.
intro.cn: agriculture 是整词借入的拉丁复合词，英语后来在它之上构造形容词与副词。

latinIntro.en: Ager, cultura and agricultura are recorded Latin words, so this entry uses no reconstructed forms.
latinIntro.cn: ager、cultura 与 agricultura 都是有记录的拉丁词，本条目不使用重构形式。

items.example: Ager is the field half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: ager 是这个复合词中「田地」的一半。

items.example: Cultura is the tending half.
The compound was borrowed whole into English.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词被整词借入英语。

items.example: It forms agricultural.
It forms agriculturally.
It forms agriculturalist.
It appears in agronomy.
Agribusiness changed the size of the farms.
items.exampleCN: 农业产业改变了农场的规模。

definition_zh: 在前面；向前；提前；领先；未来
definition_en: further forward in space or in progress, or earlier than a planned time
core_image: 队伍最前面的那个人，身后跟着一长串脚步
scene: 跑道上已经冲过弯道，只剩最后一段直道。The cyclist was already far ahead when the bell rang.
sceneCN: 这里 ahead 是「领先、在前面」（第 4 个义项：在竞争或行进中处于更前的位置）；句意为铃声响起时，那位骑手已经远远领先。

pos.zh: 副词：在前面；向前；提前；领先

derivatives.zh: 由 go 加 ahead 构成的复合词，义为「许可；放行」
由 look 加 ahead 构成的复合词，义为「前瞻的；预判的」

senses.title: Further forward in space
senses.definition: at a position in front of the speaker or of a moving person
senses.definitionCN: 位于说话者或行进者前方的位置上
senses.example: The road bends left just ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 道路就在前面向左弯。
senses.why: The word is literally on head: the old phrase meant at the front, and the front is the space ahead.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面上是「在头上」：古语指「在头前」，而头朝的方向就是前方的空间。

senses.title: Onwards in direction
senses.definition: moving or pointing in the direction one faces
senses.definitionCN: 朝所面对的方向移动或延伸
senses.example: She kept walking straight ahead without looking back.
senses.exampleCN: 她一直向前走，没有回头。
senses.why: Once ahead names the front, motion towards that front becomes going ahead.
senses.whyCN: 一旦 ahead 指「前方」，朝那个前方移动就成了 go ahead。

senses.title: Earlier than planned
senses.definition: before the expected or agreed time
senses.definitionCN: 在预期或约定的时间之前
senses.example: The bridge opened three weeks ahead of schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 大桥提前三周通车。
senses.why: Time is treated as a line one walks along, so being early is being further along the line.
senses.whyCN: 时间被当作一条可以走的线，因此更早就是在这条线上更靠前。

senses.title: In the lead
senses.definition: in front of competitors in a race, contest, or comparison
senses.definitionCN: 在比赛、竞争或比较中处于对手之前
senses.example: The cyclist was already far ahead when the bell rang.
senses.exampleCN: 铃声响起时，那位骑手已经远远领先。
senses.why: A race is a line too, and whoever stands further along it is ahead of the rest.
senses.whyCN: 比赛也是一条线，站在更靠前位置的人就领先其余的人。

senses.title: In the future
senses.definition: in the time that is still to come
senses.definitionCN: 在尚未到来的时间里
senses.example: There are difficult choices ahead for the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 整个团队今后还有艰难的选择。
senses.why: If the future lies in the direction we walk, it is literally ahead of us.
senses.whyCN: 如果未来位于我们行走的方向上，它字面上就在我们前面。

intro.en: Ahead is a native English compound of the preposition a-, meaning on, and head.
intro.cn: ahead 是英语本族的复合词，由表示「在」的 a- 与 head「头」构成。

items.en: Hēafod meant head, and it is the source of modern head.
items.cn: 古英语 hēafod 意为「头」，是现代 head 的来源。

items.en: The unstressed prefix a- came from on or at, and it survives in asleep and alive.
items.cn: 弱读前缀 a- 来自 on 或 at，今天还保留在 asleep 与 alive 里。

items.en: The phrase a-head meant at the head or in front, first used of ships and positions.
items.cn: 短语 a-head 意为「在头部、在前方」，最早用于船只与位置。

items.en: The written form ahead is recorded in the seventeenth century, first of place and later of time. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 连写形式 ahead 在十七世纪有记录，先用于空间，后来才用于时间。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The time and competition senses grew in later usage, giving fixed phrases such as ahead of schedule and go ahead.
items.cn: 时间义与竞争义属后来的发展，形成 ahead of schedule、go ahead 等固定短语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the head element or the a- pattern; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs of forward position and earlier time.
note.cn: 形近组共享 head 这一成分或 a- 这一构词模式；近义组收表示前方位置与更早时间的副词。

entries.definition: The body part and the front or top of anything, which is the literal core of ahead.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「头；前端」，是 ahead 的字面核心。

entries.definition: Permission to proceed, or an energetic person who takes the lead.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「许可、放行」，也可指有冲劲、带头的人。

entries.definition: In or to another country; it uses the same a- pattern but comes from broad, not from head.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在国外、到国外」；构词形似，同样有 a- 前缀，但词根是 broad 而非 head。

entries.definition: Towards the front or towards progress, close to ahead in its motion sense.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「向前」，接近 ahead 表示方向的那一义。

entries.definition: Continuing forward from a point, often used of journeys and progress.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「继续向前」，多用于行程与进展。

entries.definition: At a position before someone or something, the plainest spatial phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「在前面」，是最朴素的空间说法。

entries.definition: Before the expected time, which matches ahead in its scheduling sense.
entries.definitionCN: 副词或形容词，义为「早」，与 ahead 表示「提前」的义项相当。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the literal head element and the fixed phrases ahead appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用字面上的 head 成分，以及 ahead 实际出现的固定短语。

normal.en: Ahead is a- plus head: at the head means at the front of the line.
normal.cn: ahead 是 a- 加 head：站在「头」的位置，就是站在队伍最前面。

normal.en: Go ahead originally meant move to the front, and now means proceed.
normal.cn: go ahead 原指走到前面，如今意为「继续、请便」。

normal.en: Ahead of schedule treats the calendar as a line you walk along faster.
normal.cn: ahead of schedule 把日历当成一条可以走得更快的线。

normal.en: Get ahead means move past others, whether in a queue or a career.
normal.cn: get ahead 意为越过别人，无论是在队列里还是在事业上。

normal.en: Look ahead means turn your head towards the future.
normal.cn: look ahead 字面是把头转向未来。

abstract.en: Picture the first walker in a long line, everyone else following the same direction.
abstract.cn: 想象一长队人里走在最前面的那个，其余人都朝同一方向跟随。

abstract.en: The same line can be a road, a calendar, or a competition table.
abstract.cn: 同一条线可以是公路、日历，也可以是一张比赛积分表。

abstract.en: Wherever the line is, whoever stands furthest along it is ahead.
abstract.cn: 无论这条线是什么，站在更靠前位置的人就是 ahead。

examples.en: The road bends left just ahead.
examples.cn: 道路就在前面向左弯。

examples.en: The bridge opened three weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 大桥提前三周通车。

examples.en: The cyclist was already far ahead when the bell rang.
examples.cn: 铃声响起时，那位骑手已经远远领先。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额，黑的」——头一直朝着黑的前方：在前面

root: 古英语 hēafod「头」加弱读前缀 a-（来自 on/at）构成 a-head「在头前、在前方」，十七世纪连写为 ahead，先指空间，后扩展到时间上的「提前」与竞争中的「领先」，并形成 go ahead、ahead of schedule 等固定短语。

sensesIntro.en: All five senses put something further along a line: a road, a direction of walking, a calendar, a race, or the stretch of time still to come.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都把某物放到一条更靠前的线上：一条路、行走的方向、一本日历、一场比赛，或尚未到来的时间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the front walker of a long line, everyone else following behind.
core.cn: 核心意象：一长队人里走在最前面的那个，其余人跟在后面。

branches.en: THE ROAD: the front of the body and the direction it faces define where ahead is.
branches.cn: 道路线：身体的前端与它所朝的方向定义了「前方」在哪里。

branches.en: THE CALENDAR: time becomes a line, and finishing early means standing further along it.
branches.cn: 日历线：时间变成一条线，提前完成就是在线上站得更靠前。

branches.en: THE RACE: a contest is the same line with rivals on it.
branches.cn: 比赛线：竞赛就是同一条线，只是线上还有对手。

branches.en: THE FUTURE: what has not happened yet lies in the direction of travel.
branches.cn: 未来线：尚未发生的事就在行进的方向上。

branches.en: THE SAME GRAMMAR: one spatial word serves both a place and a ranking.
branches.cn: 同形线：同一个空间词既指位置，也指名次。

intro.en: Ahead is a native English compound with no Latin part: the prefix a- plus the noun head.
intro.cn: ahead 是英语本族复合词，不含拉丁成分：前缀 a- 加名词 head。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin relatives, so the Latin entries remain empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁同族词，因此拉丁条目留空。

items.example: It appears in asleep and alive.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 asleep 与 alive 中。

items.example: It became the modern word head.
The head of the line stood still.
items.exampleCN: 队伍最前面的人站着不动。

items.example: We finished ahead of the other team.
Go ahead and open the letter.
They gave the project the go-ahead.
items.exampleCN: 他们给这个项目开了绿灯。

items.example: The system uses a look-ahead method.
items.exampleCN: 这套系统采用前瞻式方法。

items.example: The crew finished ahead of schedule.

derivatives.zh: 由 go 加 ahead 构成的复合词，义为「许可；放行」
由 look 加 ahead 构成的复合词，义为「前瞻的」

definition_zh: 援助；帮助；助手；辅助器具；救援物资
definition_en: help given to someone in need, or a person or thing that helps
core_image: 一只手伸过去，把快要倒下的人扶稳
scene: 山路上有人摔伤，同行的人掏出绷带和药水。A passing driver gave first aid before the ambulance arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 aid 是「救助、援助」（第 1 个义项：给处于困难或危险中的人提供帮助）；句意为一位路过的司机在救护车到达前先做了急救。

pos.zh: 名词：援助；助手；辅助器具
动词：帮助；有助于

derivatives.zh: 由否定前缀 un- 加过去分词构成，义为「无外力帮助的」
由本词加后缀 -ed 构成，义为「有辅助的」，如计算机辅助的
由短语 first aid 加施事后缀构成，义为「急救员」

senses.title: Help given to someone in need
senses.definition: help, especially money, food, or services, given to people or countries in difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 给予处于困难中的人或国家的帮助，尤指钱、食物或服务
senses.example: A passing driver gave first aid before the ambulance arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 一位路过的司机在救护车到达前先做了急救。
senses.why: Latin adjutare meant to help, and help offered in a crisis is the sense the word kept in English.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 adjutare 意为「帮助」，危机中伸出的援手正是这个词在英语里保留的意思。

senses.title: A person who helps
senses.definition: a person who assists someone, often in a practical or military role
senses.definitionCN: 协助某人的人，常指实际事务或军事中的帮手
senses.example: The general arrived with two trusted aids.
senses.exampleCN: 将军带着两名信任的助手抵达。
senses.why: The noun can name the help itself or the person who supplies it, by a simple transfer from act to actor.
senses.whyCN: 名词可以指帮助本身，也可以指提供帮助的人，这是从动作到施事的简单转移。

senses.title: Material relief for a country
senses.definition: food, medicine, or money sent to relieve a disaster or a poor region
senses.definitionCN: 为缓解灾情或贫困地区而送去的食品、药品或资金
senses.example: The port received foreign aid after the floods.
senses.exampleCN: 洪灾之后，这个港口收到了外国援助。
senses.why: Aid became countable in relief work, where shipments can be counted and delivered.
senses.whyCN: 在救援事务中，援助可以一批批清点、运送，于是 aid 变得可数。

senses.title: A device that assists a sense
senses.definition: a device that improves a weak sense or function, such as hearing
senses.definitionCN: 改善薄弱感官或功能的装置，如助听
senses.example: She has worn a hearing aid since childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 她从小就戴助听器。
senses.why: Once aid means a thing that helps, instruments can be named after the help they give.
senses.whyCN: 既然 aid 可以指「起帮助作用的东西」，器具就可以按它提供的帮助来命名。

senses.title: To help something happen
senses.definition: to help a person or process, often by making it easier or faster
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人或某个过程，常指使其更容易或更快
senses.example: Clear labels aid readers who are in a hurry.
senses.exampleCN: 清楚的标签能帮助赶时间的读者。
senses.why: The verb is the noun in action: giving the help rather than naming it.
senses.whyCN: 动词是名词的行动化：给出帮助，而不是命名帮助。

intro.en: Aid came through Old French from a Latin verb meaning to help, and it has stayed close to that meaning.
intro.cn: aid 经古法语来自一个意为「帮助」的拉丁动词，词义一直贴近这个本义。

items.en: Juvare meant to help or to give pleasure, and it also stands behind the word adjutant.
items.cn: 拉丁语 juvare 意为「帮助、使高兴」，副官一词 adjutant 也出自它。

items.en: Ad plus juvare formed adjutare, to give help to someone, with the prefix pointing the help at a person.
items.cn: ad 加 juvare 构成 adjutare，意为「向某人提供帮助」，前缀把帮助指向某个人。

items.en: Old French aide meant help or a helper, and it entered English in both senses.
items.cn: 古法语 aide 既指帮助，也指帮手，两种意思都进入了英语。

items.en: The noun is recorded in the thirteenth century and the verb soon after. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 名词在十三世纪有记录，动词紧随其后出现。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Foreign aid, first aid and hearing aid are later fixed phrases that split the general word into concrete kinds of help.
items.cn: foreign aid、first aid、hearing aid 都是后来固定的短语，把笼统的「帮助」分成了具体的种类。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the same family and the closely related spelling aide; the near-meaning group gathers verbs and nouns of helping.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词族，以及拼写极近的 aide；近义组收表示「帮助」的动词与名词。

entries.definition: A personal assistant, especially to a senior official; it is a separate noun borrowed from French, with the same origin.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「助手、副官」，尤指高级官员的助手；它是从法语另借的名词，拼写不同但来源相同。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning supported by a device or system, as in computer-aided design.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有辅助的」，如计算机辅助设计。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning done without any help or instrument.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「无外力帮助的」，由否定前缀加过去分词构成。

entries.definition: The most general word for making things easier for someone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「帮助」，范围最广、最日常。

entries.definition: To help someone do a task, often in a secondary role; slightly formal.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「协助」，多指在次要位置上帮忙，语气略正式。

entries.definition: To give practical or emotional backing over time, broader than a single act of aid.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「支持」，指长期的实际或情感支撑，比单次援助范围更广。

entries.definition: Help given to people in a disaster, with stress on removing distress.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「救济、救援」，强调解除困境，多用于灾后。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Latin help root and the fixed phrases aid appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用拉丁「帮助」词根，以及 aid 实际出现的固定短语。

normal.en: Adjutare is to give help to someone, and aid is that help standing alone.
normal.cn: adjutare 意为「向某人提供帮助」，aid 就是这份帮助单独成词。

normal.en: First aid is the help given in the first minutes, before professionals arrive.
normal.cn: first aid 指专业人员到达前最初几分钟内给出的救助。

normal.en: Hearing aid is a device named after the help it gives to the ear.
normal.cn: hearing aid 是按它给耳朵提供的帮助来命名的装置。

normal.en: With the aid of means using something as a tool or support.
normal.cn: with the aid of 意为把某物当作工具或依托来使用。

normal.en: Aide with the e is a person, usually at the side of an official.
normal.cn: 带 e 的 aide 指人，通常是官员身边的助手。

abstract.en: Picture one hand reaching out to steady someone who is about to fall.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸出去，扶住快要倒下的人。

abstract.en: The hand can hold a bandage, a bag of grain, a hearing device, or a clear set of labels.
abstract.cn: 这只手可以拿着绷带、一袋粮食、一副助听器，或者一套清楚的标签。

abstract.en: In every version the same thing happens: the weight is shared, and the fall is stopped.
abstract.cn: 每一种情形里发生的都是同一件事：重量被分担，倒下被止住。

examples.en: A passing driver gave first aid before the ambulance arrived.
examples.cn: 一位路过的司机在救护车到达前先做了急救。

examples.en: The port received foreign aid after the floods.
examples.cn: 洪灾之后，这个港口收到了外国援助。

examples.en: Clear labels aid readers who are in a hurry.
examples.cn: 清楚的标签能帮助赶时间的读者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶的」——诶，递过去一只手：援助

root: 拉丁语 juvare「帮助、使高兴」加前缀 ad-「向」构成 adjutare「向某人提供帮助」，经古法语 aide 进入英语；名词兼指「帮助」与「帮手」，并固定出 first aid、foreign aid、hearing aid 等具体说法。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses all describe support given to something weaker: a person in danger, a person who assists, a country in disaster, a weak sense, or a slow process.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都描述给予较弱一方的支撑：危险中的人、身边的帮手、受灾的国家、薄弱的感官，或缓慢的过程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand reaches out and steadies a person who is about to fall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸出去，把快要倒下的人扶稳。

branches.en: THE CRISIS: the first sense is help at the moment it is most needed.
branches.cn: 危机线：第一个义项是最需要帮助那一刻伸出的援手。

branches.en: THE HELPER: the noun shifts from the act of helping to the person who helps.
branches.cn: 帮手线：名词从「帮助」这一动作转到提供帮助的人。

branches.en: THE SHIPMENT: help becomes sacks and crates that can be counted and delivered.
branches.cn: 物资线：帮助变成可以清点、运送的一袋袋一箱箱。

branches.en: THE DEVICE: an instrument is named after the help it gives to a sense.
branches.cn: 器具线：装置按它给某个感官提供的帮助来命名。

branches.en: THE VERB: the same help becomes an action applied to a process.
branches.cn: 动词线：同一份帮助变成施加在某个过程上的动作。

intro.en: Aid is a Latin-derived noun and verb; the family grows with English prefixes and suffixes, not with new roots.
intro.cn: aid 是源自拉丁语的名词兼动词，词族靠英语前缀与后缀扩展，不再引入新词根。

latinIntro.en: Juvare and adjutare are recorded Latin verbs, so no reconstructed form is used here.
latinIntro.cn: juvare 与 adjutare 都是有记录的拉丁动词，此处不使用重构形式。

items.example: It points the help at someone.
Juvare also stands behind adjutant.
items.exampleCN: juvare 也是 adjutant 的来源。

items.example: The verb is the direct source of aid.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是 aid 的直接来源。

items.example: The French noun supplied both senses.
items.exampleCN: 这个法语名词提供了两种意思。

items.example: It forms unaided.
It forms aided.
It forms first-aider.
He learned first aid at school.

derivatives.zh: 由否定前缀加过去分词构成，义为「无外力帮助的」
由本词加后缀构成，义为「有辅助的」
由短语加施事后缀构成，义为「急救员」

definition_zh: 瞄准；旨在；目标；目的；针对
definition_en: to point something at a target, or to intend to achieve something; the target or purpose itself
core_image: 准星、靶心与一只稳住的手连成一条直线
scene: 射击场上，选手屏住呼吸，把准星移向靶子中央。She aimed carefully at the centre of the target and fired.
sceneCN: 这里 aim 是「瞄准」（第 1 个义项：把武器或视线对准目标）；句意为她仔细瞄准靶心后开枪。

pos.zh: 动词：瞄准；旨在；针对
名词：目标；目的；准头

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀 -less 构成，义为「无目标的；漫无目的的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「漫无目的地」
由形容词加后缀 -ness 构成，义为「漫无目的」

senses.title: To point a weapon or object at a target
senses.definition: to point a weapon, tool, or device in the direction of a target
senses.definitionCN: 把武器、工具或装置指向目标所在的方向
senses.example: She aimed carefully at the centre of the target and fired.
senses.exampleCN: 她仔细瞄准靶心后开枪。
senses.why: The word began as a verb meaning to estimate, and estimating where a missile will go became pointing it there.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是意为「估量」的动词，估量弹丸会落在哪里，就变成了把它指向那里。

senses.title: To intend to achieve something
senses.definition: to plan or try to achieve a particular result
senses.definitionCN: 计划或努力达到某个特定结果
senses.example: The course aims to help students write clear reports.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课旨在帮助学生写出清楚的报告。
senses.why: A purpose is a target that is not physical, so the same verb serves both an arrow and an intention.
senses.whyCN: 目的是一种非实体的靶子，于是同一个动词既服务于箭，也服务于意图。

senses.title: A purpose or objective
senses.definition: the result that a plan or action is intended to produce
senses.definitionCN: 计划或行动意图产生的结果
senses.example: The main aim of the meeting was to settle the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 这次会议的主要目的是把预算定下来。
senses.why: The target itself, once named, becomes a noun: the thing at which everything is pointed.
senses.whyCN: 靶子本身一旦被命名，就成了名词：所有动作都指向的那个东西。

senses.title: To direct something at a person
senses.definition: to direct a remark, product, or action at a particular group
senses.definitionCN: 把言论、产品或行动指向某个特定群体
senses.example: The advertisement aims at young families in cities.
senses.exampleCN: 这则广告面向城市里的年轻家庭。
senses.why: If a physical aim can point at a thing, a message can point at an audience in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 既然实体的瞄准可以指向某物，讯息也可以用同样的方式指向某群受众。

senses.title: An intention behind an action
senses.definition: the underlying intention with which something is done, sometimes kept unspoken
senses.definitionCN: 做某事时背后的意图，有时并不说出
senses.example: Her aim in asking was simply to learn the facts.
senses.exampleCN: 她提问的意图只是想弄清事实。
senses.why: An aim can stay in the mind, unnamed, and still guide what a person does.
senses.whyCN: 靶子可以只留在心里、不被说出，却仍然引导一个人的行动。

senses.title: Accuracy in pointing
senses.definition: the ability to point accurately, or the accuracy of a shot
senses.definitionCN: 准确指向的能力，或射击的准确程度
senses.example: His aim was steady even after the long climb.
senses.exampleCN: 长途攀爬之后，他的准头依然很稳。
senses.why: Once aiming is an act, the quality of that act needs a name, and the noun supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 既然瞄准是一个动作，这个动作的好坏就需要一个名字，名词正好提供它。

intro.en: Aim comes from a French verb meaning to estimate, and estimating turned into pointing at a target.
intro.cn: aim 来自一个意为「估量」的法语动词，而「估量」又演变为「对准目标」。

items.en: Aestimare meant to estimate, value, or judge, and it is also the source of estimate.
items.cn: 拉丁语 aestimare 意为「估量、评价、判断」，estimate 也出自它。

items.en: Esmer or amer meant to estimate, guess, or intend, and it carried the word towards English.
items.cn: 古法语 esmer 或 amer 意为「估量、猜测、打算」，把这个词带向英语。

items.en: The verb appears in English meaning to estimate or to intend; the sense of pointing a weapon develops later. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个动词在英语中出现时意为「估量、打算」；指瞄准武器的义项是后来才发展出来的。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The noun aim is recorded in the sixteenth century, first as the act of aiming and then as the target itself.
items.cn: 名词 aim 在十六世纪有记录，先指瞄准这一动作，再指靶子本身。

items.en: The abstract senses of purpose and intention became the most common, so aim now usually means a goal rather than a weapon.
items.cn: 表示目的与意图的抽象义成为最常用的义项，如今 aim 通常指目标而非武器。

note.en: The look-alike group is the aim family; the near-meaning group gathers words for targets and intentions.
note.cn: 形近组是 aim 词族；近义组收表示靶子与意图的词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning without any purpose or direction.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「无目标的、漫无目的的」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The adverb for wandering or acting with no target in view.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「漫无目的地」，由形容词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The noun for the state of having no aim at all.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「漫无目的」，指完全没有目标的状态。

entries.definition: A result one works towards, often long-term and personal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，多指长期、个人努力追求的结果。

entries.definition: A concrete target set by an organization or plan; formal in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，指组织或计划设定的具体目标，语气正式。

entries.definition: The physical object aimed at, and by extension any figure to be reached.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「靶子、指标」，既指实际靶标，也引申为要达到的数字。

entries.definition: What a person means to do, whether or not it is stated.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「意图」，指一个人打算做什么，无论是否说出。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the estimating origin and the phrases aim appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用「估量」这一来源，以及 aim 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Aestimare means to estimate, so aiming is first working out where the shot will land.
normal.cn: aestimare 意为「估量」，所以瞄准首先是算清弹丸会落在哪里。

normal.en: Aim at for a target, aim to for an intention: the small word after aim decides everything.
normal.cn: aim at 接靶子，aim to 接意图：aim 后面那个小词决定一切。

normal.en: Take aim is the moment before release, when the whole body stops moving.
normal.cn: take aim 是出手前那一刻，整个身体都停下来。

normal.en: With the aim of turns the target into a reason for acting.
normal.cn: with the aim of 把靶子变成行动的理由。

normal.en: Aimless is the word for motion with no target at all.
normal.cn: aimless 指完全没有目标的移动。

abstract.en: Picture a sight, a target centre, and a steady hand joining into one straight line.
abstract.cn: 想象准星、靶心与一只稳住的手连成一条直线。

abstract.en: Replace the target with a goal on paper and the line still holds.
abstract.cn: 把靶子换成纸上的一个目标，这条线依然成立。

abstract.en: Remove the target completely and the hand keeps moving: that is aimlessness.
abstract.cn: 把靶子完全拿掉，手还在动：那就是漫无目的。

examples.en: She aimed carefully at the centre of the target and fired.
examples.cn: 她仔细瞄准靶心后开枪。

examples.en: The course aims to help students write clear reports.
examples.cn: 这门课旨在帮助学生写出清楚的报告。

examples.en: His aim was steady even after the long climb.
examples.cn: 长途攀爬之后，他的准头依然很稳。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶，瞄」——诶，瞄准了再动手：瞄准

root: 拉丁语 aestimare「估量、评价」经古法语 esmer「估量、打算」进入英语为 aim；由「估量落点」发展出「瞄准」，再扩展为「旨在、针对」，名词则指靶子、目的与准头。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses run along one line from eye to target: pointing a weapon, planning a result, naming the result, directing a message, holding a private intention, and measuring how steady the pointing is.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项沿着从眼到靶的一条线展开：把武器指过去、计划一个结果、给这个结果命名、把讯息指向某群人、把意图留在心里，以及衡量指得有多稳。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sight, a target centre, and a steady hand form one straight line.
core.cn: 核心意象：准星、靶心与一只稳住的手连成一条直线。

branches.en: THE LINE: aiming is the physical act, and the noun aim measures how true the line is.
branches.cn: 直线线：瞄准是物理动作，名词 aim 则衡量这条线有多准。

branches.en: THE TARGET: the thing at the end of the line becomes a noun in its own right.
branches.cn: 靶心线：线尽头那个东西本身成了一个名词。

branches.en: THE PLAN: a result that has not happened yet is a target placed in the future.
branches.cn: 计划线：尚未发生的结果，就是一个放在未来的靶子。

branches.en: THE AUDIENCE: a message can be pointed at a group as a weapon is pointed at a mark.
branches.cn: 受众线：讯息可以像武器指向靶标那样指向一群人。

branches.en: THE HIDDEN AIM: the target may never be shown, yet it still guides the hand.
branches.cn: 暗靶线：靶子可能从不示人，却仍在引导那只手。

intro.en: Aim is a French-derived verb and noun; English adds -less and its adverbs to complete the family.
intro.cn: aim 是源自法语的动词兼名词，英语用 -less 及其副词形式补全词族。

latinIntro.en: Aestimare is recorded Latin, so the root here is not a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: aestimare 是有记录的拉丁词，此处词根不是重构形式。

items.example: It also gives the English word estimate.
The French verb is the route into English.
items.exampleCN: 这个法语动词是进入英语的路径。

items.example: It forms aimless.
It forms aimlessly.
It forms aimlessness.
They aimed at the far post.
items.exampleCN: 他们瞄准了远端的门柱。

items.example: We aim to finish by June.
She wrote with the aim of changing one mind.
items.exampleCN: 她写作是为了改变一个人的想法。

definition_en: the mixture of gases we breathe, the space above the ground, or a manner that someone shows

scene: 清晨推开窗，屋里闷了一夜的浊气慢慢散出去。She opened the windows wide to let fresh air into the room.
sceneCN: 这里 air 是「空气」（第 1 个义项：我们呼吸的那种气体）；句意为她把窗子大开，让新鲜空气进屋。

senses.title: The gas mixture we breathe
senses.definition: the invisible mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that living things breathe
senses.definitionCN: 包围地球、生物呼吸所用的看不见的混合气体
senses.example: She opened the windows wide to let fresh air into the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她把窗子大开，让新鲜空气进屋。
senses.why: Greek aēr first named the lower, misty layer of the world, and that layer is what we breathe.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 aēr 最初指世界下方那层带雾气的空间，那正是我们呼吸的东西。

senses.title: The sky and the space above
senses.definition: the open space above the ground, where birds and clouds are seen
senses.definitionCN: 地面上方的开阔空间，鸟与云所在之处
senses.example: The kite rose high into the air.
senses.exampleCN: 风筝高高飞上天空。
senses.why: The same substance that fills a room also fills the open sky, so one word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 填满房间的那种东西也填满开阔的天空，于是同一个词覆盖两者。

senses.title: Travel or transport by flying
senses.definition: the use of aircraft for travel or for carrying goods
senses.definitionCN: 用航空器载人或运货的方式
senses.example: The spare parts were sent by air.
senses.exampleCN: 这些备件是空运过去的。
senses.why: Since aircraft move through the air, the medium becomes the name of the whole method.
senses.whyCN: 既然航空器在空中移动，这个介质就成了整套运输方式的名称。

senses.title: A manner or appearance someone shows
senses.definition: a noticeable manner, mood, or quality that a person or place seems to have
senses.definitionCN: 人或者地方显露出来的、能被察觉的神情、气氛或特质
senses.example: The old house had an air of mystery about it.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老房子带着一股神秘的气息。
senses.why: French air also meant bearing or appearance, as if a mood were something worn around a person.
senses.whyCN: 法语 air 也指举止与外貌，仿佛一种情绪像外衣一样穿在人身上。

senses.title: A melody or tune
senses.definition: a short piece of music or a tune, used especially in older or literary writing
senses.definitionCN: 一段短曲或旋律，多见于较早或文学性的文字
senses.example: The musicians played a simple air on two flutes.
senses.exampleCN: 乐手们用两支长笛吹了一段简单的曲调。
senses.why: This sense came through French and Italian musical use, where a tune was a manner of singing.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项经法语与意大利语的音乐用法而来，那里「曲调」是一种歌唱的方式。

senses.title: To dry or freshen something
senses.definition: to expose clothes, bedding, or a room to the open air so that it dries or freshens
senses.definitionCN: 把衣物、被褥或房间置于空气中，使其干燥或换气
senses.example: She aired the blankets on the balcony all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她整个上午都在阳台上晾被子。
senses.why: If air is the substance, the verb turns it into an action: letting the substance do its work.
senses.whyCN: 如果 air 是那种物质，动词就是让它发挥作用：把它请进来做事。

senses.title: To express views publicly
senses.definition: to make an opinion or complaint public, so that others hear it
senses.definitionCN: 把看法或不满公开说出来，让别人听到
senses.example: Members aired their concerns before the vote.
senses.exampleCN: 成员们在投票前说出了他们的顾虑。
senses.why: Speaking a view is sending it out into the open, where anyone can hear it.
senses.whyCN: 把看法说出来，就是把它放到开阔处，谁都能听见。

senses.title: To broadcast a programme
senses.definition: to send a programme out by radio, television, or the internet
senses.definitionCN: 通过广播、电视或网络把节目发送出去
senses.example: The station will air the interview on Sunday evening.
senses.exampleCN: 电台将在周日晚上播出这段访谈。
senses.why: Broadcasting sends sound or pictures through the air, so the medium became the verb for transmitting.
senses.whyCN: 广播让声音与画面经由空中传播，于是这个介质成了表示「发送」的动词。

intro.en: Air came from Greek through Latin and French, and its senses spread from the breathable gas to the sky, to manner, and to broadcast.
intro.cn: air 经拉丁语与法语来自希腊语，词义从可呼吸的气体扩展到天空、神态，再到播送。

items.en: Aēr named the lower, misty air near the earth, as opposed to the pure upper ether.
items.cn: 希腊语 aēr 指靠近地面的、带雾气的下层空气，与纯净的上层以太相对。

items.en: Latin borrowed aer and used it for the air and the atmosphere.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 aer，用来指空气与大气。

items.en: Old French air carried both the physical sense and the sense of appearance or bearing.
items.cn: 古法语 air 同时带有物理义与「外貌、举止」义。

items.en: The word is recorded in English in the thirteenth century; the musical sense came later through French and Italian use. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词在十三世纪见于英语；音乐义经法语与意大利语用法稍后传入。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The verb senses of drying, expressing, and broadcasting grew from the idea of putting something out into the open.
items.cn: 动词的晾晒义、表达义与播送义，都从「把东西放到开阔处」这一观念生长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group is the air family; the near-meaning group gathers words for atmosphere, sky, and manner.
note.cn: 形近组是 air 词族；近义组收表示大气、天空与神态的词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning open to the air, light, or casual in manner.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「通风的、轻快的」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning with no fresh air and therefore stuffy.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不通风的、闷的」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The noun for drying something in the air or for a broadcast.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「晾晒、播出」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The envelope of gases around the earth, or the mood of a place.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大气层；气氛」，既可指地球周围的气体，也可指场所的氛围。

entries.definition: A light wind, a movement of the air rather than the air itself.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「微风」，指空气的流动而非空气本身。

entries.definition: The space above the earth as seen from below, treated as a visible dome.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「天空」，指从地面向上看到的那个可见的穹顶。

entries.definition: The way a person behaves or appears, close to air in its bearing sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「举止、态度」，接近 air 表示神态的义项。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek origin and the phrases air appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用希腊语来源，以及 air 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Aer is the misty lower air, the layer we actually breathe.
normal.cn: aēr 是带雾气的下层空气，正是我们真正呼吸的那一层。

normal.en: One substance fills a room and the sky, so air covers both.
normal.cn: 同一种物质填满房间也填满天空，所以 air 两者都指。

normal.en: By air means the aircraft takes you through the same medium.
normal.cn: by air 指航空器带你穿过同一个介质。

normal.en: An air of mystery is a mood worn like a coat.
normal.cn: an air of mystery 是一种像外套一样穿在身上的气氛。

normal.en: To air a room is to let the substance do the work of cleaning it.
normal.cn: air a room 就是让这种物质去完成清洁的工作。

abstract.en: Picture a layer of invisible gas holding a falling feather and carrying a voice at the same time.
abstract.cn: 想象一层看不见的气，同时托住落下的羽毛与传走的声音。

abstract.en: The same layer can surround a person and become the mood they carry.
abstract.cn: 同一层气也可以围住一个人，变成他身上带的气氛。

abstract.en: Send something out into that layer and it is aired, whether it is a blanket or an opinion.
abstract.cn: 把东西放到那层气里，它就「被晾出去」了，无论是一条被子还是一种看法。

examples.en: She opened the windows wide to let fresh air into the room.
examples.cn: 她把窗子大开，让新鲜空气进屋。

examples.en: The old house had an air of mystery about it.
examples.cn: 那座老房子带着一股神秘的气息。

examples.en: Members aired their concerns before the vote.
examples.cn: 成员们在投票前说出了他们的顾虑。

root: 希腊语 aēr「下层带雾的空气」经拉丁语 aer 与古法语 air 进入英语；由「可呼吸之气」扩展为天空、航空，又经法语「举止、外貌」义发展出神态义，音乐义经法语与意大利语用法传入，动词义则由「放到开阔处」引申为晾晒、表达与播送。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses spread from one substance: the gas itself, the space it fills, travel through it, a mood worn in it, a tune carried by it, and three actions that put things out into it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从同一种物质展开：气体本身、它填满的空间、穿行其中的旅行、穿在身上的气氛、借它传出的曲调，以及三种把东西放到其中的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an invisible layer of gas holds a falling feather and carries a voice away.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层看不见的气托住落下的羽毛，也把声音带走。

branches.en: THE LUNG: the gas is first of all what living things breathe.
branches.cn: 肺线：这种气体首先是生物呼吸所用的东西。

branches.en: THE SKY: the same layer opens overhead, and flight makes it a route.
branches.cn: 天空线：同一层气在头顶展开，飞行又把它变成一条路线。

branches.en: THE FACE: a mood seems to surround a person like the air around a body.
branches.cn: 面容线：一种情绪像身体周围的气一样围着一个人。

branches.en: THE TUNE: a melody is carried through the same medium and named after a manner of singing.
branches.cn: 旋律线：曲调经由同一介质传出，并按一种歌唱方式得名。

branches.en: THE OPEN: drying, speaking, and broadcasting all place something where others can reach it.
branches.cn: 开阔线：晾晒、说出与播送都是把某物放到别人够得着的地方。

intro.en: Air is a borrowed root with no living prefix; English builds adjectives and nouns with -y, -less and -ing.
intro.cn: air 是借入的词根，没有仍在使用的前缀；英语用 -y、-less 与 -ing 构造形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: Aer is recorded in both Greek and Latin, so the root is attested rather than reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: aer 在希腊语与拉丁语中均有记录，词根属于有据可查而非重构。

由本词加后缀构成，义为「不通风的」

definition_zh: 航空器；飞机；军用飞机；无人机
definition_en: any vehicle that can fly through the air, including planes, helicopters, and drones
core_image: 一排不同形状的机翼停在同一片停机坪上
scene: 机场的停机坪上，一架银灰色的飞机正被牵引车缓缓拖动。The airport handled every type of aircraft, from small trainers to wide-body jets.
sceneCN: 这里 aircraft 是「航空器（总称）」（第 1 个义项：任何能在大气中飞行的载具）；句意为这座机场处理各种航空器，从小型教练机到宽体喷气机。

pos.zh: 名词：航空器；飞机

senses.title: Any flying vehicle
senses.definition: any machine that can fly through the air, whether it carries people or not
senses.definitionCN: 任何能在大气中飞行的机器，无论是否载人
senses.example: The airport handled every type of aircraft, from small trainers to wide-body jets.
senses.exampleCN: 这座机场处理各种航空器，从小型教练机到宽体喷气机。
senses.why: Craft meant a skill and then a vessel, so air plus craft names any machine built to travel in the air.
senses.whyCN: craft 先指技艺，后指载具，于是 air 加 craft 就指任何为空中行进而造的机器。

senses.title: A fixed-wing aeroplane
senses.definition: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings, especially in ordinary speech
senses.definitionCN: 带固定机翼的动力飞行器，尤用于日常口语
senses.example: The aircraft taxied to the runway and waited for clearance.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机滑行到跑道，等待起飞许可。
senses.why: In everyday use the general word narrowed to the most common kind, the aeroplane.
senses.whyCN: 在日常使用中，这个总称缩小到最常见的那一种，也就是飞机。

senses.title: A military flying machine
senses.definition: a flying machine used by armed forces, including fighters and transports
senses.definitionCN: 武装部队使用的飞行器，包括战斗机与运输机
senses.example: Two military aircraft circled above the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 两架军用飞机在山谷上方盘旋。
senses.why: The compound was adopted by aviation and the military before it belonged to everyday speech.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词先在航空与军事领域使用，之后才进入日常语言。

senses.title: An unmanned flying vehicle
senses.definition: a flying vehicle flown without a pilot on board, controlled remotely or by software
senses.definitionCN: 机上没有驾驶员、由远程或程序控制的飞行器
senses.example: Small aircraft now map fields without a pilot.
senses.exampleCN: 小型无人航空器如今不用驾驶员就能测绘农田。
senses.why: Since the word means any flying machine, pilotless machines fit the same definition.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词指任何飞行机器，无人驾驶的机器同样符合这个定义。

intro.en: Aircraft joins two native English words: air and craft, which first meant skill and later a vessel.
intro.cn: aircraft 由两个英语本族词合成：air 与 craft，后者先指技艺，后指载具。

items.en: Cræft meant strength, skill, or a craft, and it is the source of modern craft.
items.cn: 古英语 cræft 意为「力量、技艺、手艺」，是现代 craft 的来源。

items.en: By the eighteenth century craft could mean a vessel or a small boat, because a boat is a product of skilled building.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，craft 已可指船只或小艇，因为船是精巧建造的产物。

items.en: Air plus craft appears in the nineteenth century for machines that travel in the air, before powered flight was achieved. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: air 加 craft 的组合同在十九世纪出现，指在空中行进的机器，当时动力飞行尚未实现。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: After the first powered flights the word settled as the general term for flying machines.
items.cn: 在最初的动力飞行之后，这个词稳定为飞行机器的总称。

items.en: Aviation law and the military use aircraft as a technical category, while everyday speech often means a plane.
items.cn: 航空法规与军队把 aircraft 当作技术类别使用，而日常口语常指飞机。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the air element or is built from aircraft; the near-meaning group gathers specific kinds of flying machines.
note.cn: 形近组共享 air 这一成分，或由 aircraft 构成；近义组收具体的飞行器种类。

entries.definition: A powered fixed-wing plane, the most common kind of aircraft in everyday use.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，是日常所指最常见的一类航空器，与 aircraft 共享 air 这一成分。

entries.definition: A low rank in some air forces, formed directly from aircraft plus man.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「空军士兵」，是某些空军中的低阶军衔，由本词加 man 构成。

entries.definition: An adjective describing defences designed to shoot at aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「防空的」，指用于射击航空器的防御手段。

entries.definition: The British word for a powered fixed-wing plane.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，是英式说法，指动力固定翼飞机。

entries.definition: A flying machine lifted by rotating blades rather than fixed wings.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「直升机」，靠旋转桨叶而非固定翼升空。

entries.definition: An aircraft driven by jet engines, usually fast and large.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「喷气式飞机」，由喷气发动机驱动，通常又快又大。

entries.definition: A small pilotless aircraft controlled remotely.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「无人机」，指远程操控的小型无人航空器。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two native words inside the compound and the phrases it appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用复合词内部的两个本族词，以及它实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Air is the medium and craft is the built vessel, so aircraft is a vessel made for the air.
normal.cn: air 是介质，craft 是造好的载具，所以 aircraft 就是为空中而造的载具。

normal.en: Craft first meant skill, which is why the same word also names a boat or a handicraft.
normal.cn: craft 最初意为技艺，所以同一个词也能指小船或手工艺品。

normal.en: Aircraft has one form for singular and plural: one aircraft, two aircraft.
normal.cn: aircraft 单复数同形：一架是 aircraft，两架也是 aircraft。

normal.en: An aircraft carrier is a ship whose whole purpose is to carry aircraft.
normal.cn: aircraft carrier 是一艘以搭载航空器为全部用途的船。

normal.en: Military aircraft and civil aircraft split the same word by who operates it.
normal.cn: military aircraft 与 civil aircraft 按使用方把同一个词分成两类。

abstract.en: Picture a row of wings of different shapes parked on one apron.
abstract.cn: 想象一排形状各异的机翼停在同一片停机坪上。

abstract.en: One of them has no pilot at all, yet it still belongs in the row.
abstract.cn: 其中一架根本没有驾驶员，却仍属于这一排。

abstract.en: The row is the category; any single machine you point at is the everyday meaning.
abstract.cn: 这一排就是类别；你随手一指的那一架，就是日常义。

examples.en: The airport handled every type of aircraft, from small trainers to wide-body jets.
examples.cn: 这座机场处理各种航空器，从小型教练机到宽体喷气机。

examples.en: Two military aircraft circled above the valley.
examples.cn: 两架军用飞机在山谷上方盘旋。

examples.en: Small aircraft now map fields without a pilot.
examples.cn: 小型无人航空器如今不用驾驶员就能测绘农田。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔，克拉夫特」——爱在空中的手艺：航空器

root: 英语本族词 air 与 craft 的复合。craft 出自古英语 cræft「力量、技艺」，十八世纪起可指船只，十九世纪出现 air 加 craft 的组合，指空中机器，二十世纪动力飞行之后成为飞行器的总称。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses run from the widest to the narrowest: every flying machine, then the fixed-wing plane, then the military kind, then the pilotless kind.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项从最宽到最窄：所有飞行机器、固定翼飞机、军用机型，再到无人驾驶机型。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of differently shaped wings parked on one apron.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排形状各异的机翼停在同一片停机坪上。

branches.en: THE CATEGORY: air plus craft names any machine built to travel in the air.
branches.cn: 类别线：air 加 craft 指任何为空中行进而造的机器。

branches.en: THE COMMON KIND: everyday speech narrows the category to the fixed-wing plane.
branches.cn: 常见线：日常口语把这一类别缩小到固定翼飞机。

branches.en: THE FORCES: the military keeps the wider word and adds its own machines to it.
branches.cn: 军线：军队保留较宽的总称，并把自己的机型纳入其中。

branches.en: THE EMPTY COCKPIT: a machine with no pilot still fits the definition of a flying craft.
branches.cn: 空座舱线：没有驾驶员的机器仍符合「飞行载具」的定义。

branches.en: THE SAME WORD: the general term and the everyday plane are one word at two levels of width.
branches.cn: 同词线：总称与日常所指的飞机，是同一个词在两个宽窄层级上。

intro.en: Aircraft is a native compound; its parts are two English nouns rather than a prefix and a root.
intro.cn: aircraft 是英语本族复合词，其成分是两个英语名词，而不是前缀加词根。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin parts, so the Latin entries remain empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词不含拉丁成分，因此拉丁条目留空。

items.meaning: the gas and space above the ground
items.example: Air is the medium the machine travels through.
items.exampleCN: air 是这种机器行进的介质。

items.example: It became the modern word craft.
The second half of the compound means a vessel.
It forms anti-aircraft.
The carrier left port at dawn.
He learned to fly in a light aircraft.
items.exampleCN: 他在轻型飞机上学会了飞行。

items.example: Civil aircraft use a separate runway.
items.exampleCN: 民用航空器使用另一条跑道。

items.example: It forms aircraftman.

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 man 构成的复合词，义为「空军士兵」
由前缀加本词构成，义为「防空的」

definition_zh: 航空公司；航线；航空客运；气动管路
definition_en: a company that carries passengers and goods by aircraft, or a route through the air
core_image: 地图上一条直直穿过云层的线，两端各有一个城市
scene: 机场大厅里，值机柜台上方的显示屏亮着不同目的地。The airline moved her to an earlier flight without charging a fee.
sceneCN: 这里 airline 是「航空公司」（第 1 个义项：经营航空运输的企业）；句意为这家航空公司免费把她改到了更早的一个航班。

pos.zh: 名词：航空公司；航线；航空客运

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀 -er 构成，义为「大型客机」
由本词加 wide 构成的复合词，义为「全航空公司范围的」

senses.title: A company that flies passengers
senses.definition: a company that owns or operates aircraft and sells flights to passengers and shippers
senses.definitionCN: 拥有或运营航空器、向旅客与货主出售航班的企业
senses.example: The airline moved her to an earlier flight without charging a fee.
senses.exampleCN: 这家航空公司免费把她改到了更早的一个航班。
senses.why: A company that runs a regular line of flights is named after that line, so the route word became the business word.
senses.whyCN: 经营固定航线的公司以这条线命名，于是「航线」这个词变成了「企业」的词。

senses.title: A route through the air
senses.definition: a fixed route that aircraft follow between two places
senses.definitionCN: 航空器在两个地点之间固定飞行的路线
senses.example: The new airline cuts two hours off the old route.
senses.exampleCN: 这条新航线比旧路线省下两个小时。
senses.why: This is the older sense: a line drawn through the air between two points.
senses.whyCN: 这是较早的义项：在两个点之间穿过空中画出的一条线。

senses.title: Air transport as a service
senses.definition: the service of carrying people or goods by air, seen as an activity rather than a company
senses.definitionCN: 以航空运送人员或货物这一服务，看作一种业务而非某家企业
senses.example: Cheap airline changed how ordinary families travel.
senses.exampleCN: 廉价航空改变了普通家庭的出行方式。
senses.why: The company name can stand for the whole activity it performs, by a common shift from doer to doing.
senses.whyCN: 企业的名称可以代表它所从事的整项活动，这是从「做事者」到「所做之事」的常见转移。

senses.title: A hose for compressed air
senses.definition: a tube or pipe that carries compressed air to a tool or machine
senses.definitionCN: 把压缩空气输送到工具或机器的软管或管道
senses.example: The mechanic replaced the worn airline behind the compressor.
senses.exampleCN: 机修工换掉了压缩机后面那根磨损的输气管。
senses.why: In engineering, a line is simply a conduit, so air plus line names a pipe rather than a company.
senses.whyCN: 在工程语境中，line 就是指一条导管，因此 air 加 line 指的是一根管子，而不是一家公司。

intro.en: Airline is a compound of air and line, where line first meant a cord or a drawn stroke and then a route.
intro.cn: airline 是 air 与 line 的复合词，line 先指绳索或画出的笔画，后指路线。

items.en: Linea meant a string, a thread, or a line drawn with a cord, and it is the source of English line.
items.cn: 拉丁语 linea 意为「绳、线、用绳拉出的直线」，是英语 line 的来源。

items.en: Line covered a cord, a drawn mark, a row, and later a route between places.
items.cn: line 覆盖绳索、画出的线、一排，后来也指两地之间的路线。

items.en: Air plus line is recorded in the nineteenth century for a straight course through the air and for pneumatic tubes. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: air 加 line 在十九世纪有记录，既指穿过空中的直线，也指气动管路。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: With regular air services the compound came to mean the company operating a route, and the sense spread worldwide.
items.cn: 随着定期航空业务出现，这个复合词开始指经营航线的公司，这一义项传遍世界。

items.en: Airline now chiefly means the company, while route and pneumatic senses survive in specialised use.
items.cn: 如今 airline 主要指公司，航线义与气动管路义只保留在专业领域。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the air element or is built from airline; the near-meaning group gathers words for carriers, routes, and flights.
note.cn: 形近组共享 air 这一成分，或由 airline 构成；近义组收表示承运方、航线与航班的词。

entries.definition: A large passenger aircraft, named after the airline that operates it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大型客机」，因运营它的航空公司而得名。

entries.definition: A powered fixed-wing aircraft; it shares air but not the second element.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，与 airline 共享 air，但后半成分不同。

entries.definition: A route used by aircraft, or a passage for air in the body or in mining.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航路」，也可指人体或矿井中的通气通道，与 airline 共享 air。

entries.definition: A company that transports people or goods, used of airlines, shipping lines, and hauliers.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「承运方」，指运送人员或货物的企业，可用于航空、航运与陆运。

entries.definition: A recognised route through the sky that aircraft are cleared to fly.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航路」，指航空器获准飞行的空中路线。

entries.definition: One journey made by an aircraft, rather than the company or the route.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航班、飞行」，指一次具体的飞行，而非公司或航线。

entries.definition: The machine itself, which the airline operates but does not name.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航空器」，指机器本身；航空公司运营它，但这个词不指公司。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the line element and the phrases airline appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用 line 这一成分，以及 airline 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: A line through the air is a route, and a company running that route took the name.
normal.cn: 穿过空中的一条线就是航线，经营这条航线的公司沿用了它的名字。

normal.en: Airline is the company; airliner is the plane it flies.
normal.cn: airline 是公司；airliner 是它飞的那架大客机。

normal.en: Budget airline sells cheap seats by cutting extras, not by shortening the line.
normal.cn: budget airline 靠削减附加服务卖便宜座位，而不是把航线缩短。

normal.en: The airline industry counts every company that flies for paying customers.
normal.cn: airline industry 把每一家为付费顾客飞行的公司都算在内。

normal.en: In a workshop, an airline is just a hose carrying compressed air.
normal.cn: 在车间里，airline 只是一根输送压缩空气的软管。

abstract.en: Picture a straight line drawn across a map, passing over clouds with a city at each end.
abstract.cn: 想象在地图上画一条直线，穿过云层，两端各有一个城市。

abstract.en: Now put a company's name on that line, and the line becomes the business.
abstract.cn: 在这条线上写上公司的名字，这条线就成了那家企业。

abstract.en: Shrink the line into a workshop and it turns into a rubber tube feeding a drill.
abstract.cn: 把这条线缩进车间，它就变成一根给气钻供气的橡皮管。

examples.en: The airline moved her to an earlier flight without charging a fee.
examples.cn: 这家航空公司免费把她改到了更早的一个航班。

examples.en: Cheap airline changed how ordinary families travel.
examples.cn: 廉价航空改变了普通家庭的出行方式。

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the worn airline behind the compressor.
examples.cn: 机修工换掉了压缩机后面那根磨损的输气管。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔，赖恩」——空中的那条线：航线、航空公司

root: 英语 air 与 line 的复合。line 出自拉丁语 linea「绳、线」，十四世纪进入英语，兼指绳索、笔画与路线；十九世纪出现 air 加 line 的组合，指空中直线与气动管路，二十世纪初定期航空业务兴起后，转指经营航线的航空公司。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses share one line: a company that runs a route, the route itself, the whole activity of flying people, and a pipe that carries air on the ground.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项共享一条线：经营航线的公司、航线本身、载人飞行这整项业务，以及地面上输送空气的管子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight line drawn through clouds on a map, a city at each end.
core.cn: 核心意象：地图上一条穿过云层的直线，两端各有一个城市。

branches.en: THE ROUTE: this is the oldest sense, a line drawn through the air.
branches.cn: 航线线：这是最早的义项，一条穿过空中画出的线。

branches.en: THE COMPANY: whoever runs the route regularly is named after it.
branches.cn: 公司线：凡定期经营这条航线者，都以它命名。

branches.en: THE SERVICE: the company's name stands for the whole activity of flying people.
branches.cn: 业务线：公司的名字代表载人飞行的整项活动。

branches.en: THE HOSE: in engineering a line is a conduit, so the compound becomes a pipe.
branches.cn: 管路线：在工程语境中 line 就是导管，于是复合词指一根管子。

branches.en: THE SAME WORD: the route and the business differ only in whether a company stands on the line.
branches.cn: 同词线：航线与公司的区别，只在于这条线上是否站着一家企业。

intro.en: Airline is a native English compound, and its family grows through -er and the combining word wide.
intro.cn: airline 是英语本族复合词，词族靠 -er 与 wide 这样的组合成分扩展。

latinIntro.en: Linea is recorded Latin, so the root of line is attested rather than reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: linea 是有记录的拉丁词，line 的词根属于有据可查而非重构。

items.example: The route runs through the air.
Linea is the source of line.
items.exampleCN: linea 是 line 的来源。

items.meaning: a route or a drawn stroke
items.example: The second half of the compound means a route.
It forms airliner.
It forms airline-wide.
Budget airline fares exclude luggage.
items.exampleCN: 廉价航空的票价不含行李。

items.example: The airline industry recovered slowly.
She printed the airline ticket at home.

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀构成，义为「大型客机」
由本词加 wide 构成的复合词，义为「全公司范围的」

definition_zh: 航空邮件；航空邮递；航空邮资
definition_en: mail carried by aircraft, the service that carries it, or the postage charged for it
core_image: 一只薄薄的信封，边角印着蓝红相间的斜纹
scene: 邮局柜台上摆着两种信封，一种边角印着蓝红斜纹。She sent the documents by airmail so they would arrive before the deadline.
sceneCN: 这里 airmail 是「航空邮递」（第 2 个义项：用航空方式寄送邮件）；句意为她把这些文件寄了航空件，好在截止日期前送到。

pos.zh: 名词：航空邮件；航空邮递；航空邮资

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀 -er 构成，义为「航空邮件；寄航空信的人」
由本词加名词后缀 -ing 构成，义为「航空寄送」

senses.title: Mail carried by aircraft
senses.definition: letters and parcels sent by aircraft instead of by ship or road
senses.definitionCN: 用航空器而非船只或陆路寄送的信件与包裹
senses.example: The airmail arrived two days earlier than the surface post.
senses.exampleCN: 航空邮件比平邮早到了两天。
senses.why: Air names the carrier and mail names what is carried, so the compound names the post itself.
senses.whyCN: air 指出运载方式，mail 指出所运之物，这个复合词因此指邮件本身。

senses.title: The service of sending mail by air
senses.definition: the postal service that uses aircraft to move mail quickly between places
senses.definitionCN: 利用航空器在各地点之间快速运送邮件的邮政业务
senses.example: She sent the documents by airmail so they would arrive before the deadline.
senses.exampleCN: 她把这些文件寄了航空件，好在截止日期前送到。
senses.why: The phrase by airmail names the method, so the compound also stands for the service that provides it.
senses.whyCN: 短语 by airmail 指的是一种方式，因此这个复合词也代表提供这种方式的服务。

senses.title: The postage charged for air transport
senses.definition: the higher rate paid for sending something by aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 为航空寄送所付的较高邮资
senses.example: The airmail rate went up again this spring.
senses.exampleCN: 今年春天航空邮资又涨了。
senses.why: Once a service exists, its price needs a name, and the compound supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 一项业务一旦存在，它的价格就需要一个名称，这个复合词正好提供。

intro.en: Airmail joins two English words: air for the method of carriage and mail for the letters themselves.
intro.cn: airmail 由两个英语词组成：air 指运送方式，mail 指信件本身。

items.en: Male meant a bag or a wallet, and mail first named the bag that carried letters.
items.cn: 古法语 male 意为「袋子、皮包」，mail 最初指装信件的袋子。

items.en: Mail came to mean the letters and parcels themselves, and later the system that moves them.
items.cn: mail 后来指信件与包裹本身，再后来指运送它们的系统。

items.en: Air plus mail appears as aircraft began carrying post; the exact first use is uncertain, and the compound spread with international services.
items.cn: 随着航空器开始运送邮件，air 与 mail 组合出现；确切首用年代不确定，这一复合词随国际邮政业务普及。

items.en: Airmail envelopes, rates, and labels became standard objects of everyday life.
items.cn: 航空信封、航空邮资与航空标签成了日常生活中的常见物件。

items.en: Electronic mail reduced the everyday use of the word, and airmail now mostly survives in postal and historical contexts.
items.cn: 电子邮件减少了这个词的日常使用，如今 airmail 多保留在邮政与历史语境中。

note.en: The look-alike group is built from airmail; the near-meaning group gathers other words for post and delivery.
note.cn: 形近组由 airmail 构成；近义组收其他表示邮政与投递的词。

entries.definition: A letter or packet sent by air, or a person who sends one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航空邮件；寄航空信的人」，由本词加后缀构成。

entries.definition: The act of sending something by air mail.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航空寄送」，指用航空邮件方式寄出。

entries.definition: The light envelope with striped edges used for air mail.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航空信封」，指边角印有斜纹的薄信封。

entries.definition: Mail carried by ship, road, or rail rather than by air.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「平邮、水陆邮件」，指经船运、陆运而非航空运送的邮件。

entries.definition: The system and the letters it handles, without saying how they travel.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「邮政、邮件」，不说明运送方式。

entries.definition: Letters and parcels, or the service that delivers them; the base of airmail.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「邮件、邮政」，是 airmail 的基础词。

entries.definition: A company or person that delivers items quickly and directly.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「快递、信使」，指快速直接投递物品的公司或人。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the bag origin of mail and the phrases airmail appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用 mail 的「袋子」来源，以及 airmail 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Mail first meant the bag that held letters, then the letters, then the system.
normal.cn: mail 先指装信的袋子，再指信，最后指整个邮政系统。

normal.en: Airmail is mail that travels by air, so the modifier tells you the carrier, not the contents.
normal.cn: airmail 是走航空的邮件，修饰语说明的是运载方式，而不是内容。

normal.en: By airmail names the method; airmail rate names the price of that method.
normal.cn: by airmail 指方式；airmail rate 指这种方式的价钱。

normal.en: The striped airmail envelope is thin because every gram costs money in the air.
normal.cn: 航空信封做得薄，因为在天上每一克都要算钱。

normal.en: Surface mail is the direct opposite: it goes by ship, road, or rail.
normal.cn: surface mail 正好相反：走海运、陆运或铁路。

abstract.en: Picture a thin striped envelope lying on a counter beside a heavier plain one.
abstract.cn: 想象柜台上放着一只薄薄的斜纹信封，旁边是一只更厚的普通信封。

abstract.en: The stripes mark a decision: this one will fly instead of sail.
abstract.cn: 那些斜纹标记着一个决定：这一只要飞，而不是走海路。

abstract.en: Speed is what the stripes buy, and the higher rate is what speed costs.
abstract.cn: 斜纹买到的是速度，而更高的邮资就是速度的代价。

examples.en: She sent the documents by airmail so they would arrive before the deadline.
examples.cn: 她把这些文件寄了航空件，好在截止日期前送到。

examples.en: The airmail arrived two days earlier than the surface post.
examples.cn: 航空邮件比平邮早到了两天。

examples.en: The airmail rate went up again this spring.
examples.cn: 今年春天航空邮资又涨了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔，妹儿」——让信飞着去找人：航空邮件

root: 英语 air 与 mail 的复合。mail 经古法语 male「袋子」进入英语，先指装信件的袋子，后指信件与邮政系统；二十世纪初航空器开始运送邮件，air 加 mail 的组合随之出现，并固定出航空信封、航空邮资等说法。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses separate what is sent, how it is sent, and what the sending costs: the mail itself, the air service, and the air rate.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项把寄的东西、寄的方式与寄的价钱分开：邮件本身、航空业务，以及航空邮资。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin envelope with blue and red stripes along its edge.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只薄薄的信封，边角印着蓝红相间的斜纹。

branches.en: THE LETTERS: the compound first names the mail that flies.
branches.cn: 信件线：这个复合词首先指走航空的那些邮件。

branches.en: THE SERVICE: by airmail names a method, and the method stands for the organisation behind it.
branches.cn: 业务线：by airmail 指的是一种方式，这种方式又代表背后的机构。

branches.en: THE PRICE: speed has a cost, and the cost takes the name of the service.
branches.cn: 价格线：速度有代价，这个代价沿用了业务的名称。

branches.en: THE SAME WORD: what is sent and how it is sent are one compound seen from two sides.
branches.cn: 同词线：寄什么与怎么寄，是同一个复合词的两个侧面。

branches.en: THE COUNTER: at the post office the service and its rate are quoted in one breath.
branches.cn: 柜台线：在邮局，业务与资费总是被一起报价。

intro.en: Airmail is a native compound, and English adds -er and -ing to name the sender and the act.
intro.cn: airmail 是英语本族复合词，英语用 -er 与 -ing 指寄件者与寄送行为。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are native or Old French in origin, so the Latin entries remain empty.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分分别源自英语本族与古法语，因此拉丁条目留空。

items.example: The post now travels by air.
Male is the source of mail.
items.exampleCN: male 是 mail 的来源。

items.example: The second half names what is carried.
items.exampleCN: 后半部分指出所运之物。

items.example: It forms airmailer.
It forms airmailing.
Send it by airmail if it is urgent.

items.meaning: mail carried by land or sea
items.example: Surface mail is cheaper but slower.
The airmail rate depends on weight.

definition_en: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings, heavier than the air it flies through
core_image: 一对固定的机翼，把机身托在气流之上
scene: 停机坪上，地勤人员推着梯子靠近舱门。The airplane waited at the gate while the crew checked the wings.
sceneCN: 这里 airplane 是「飞机」（第 1 个义项：美式常用词，指动力固定翼飞机）；句意为飞机停在登机口，机组人员在检查机翼。

pos.zh: 名词：飞机；航空器

derivatives.zh: 本词的英式拼写形式，义为「飞机」
由本词加 mode 构成的复合词，义为「飞行模式」

senses.title: A powered fixed-wing aircraft
senses.definition: a flying vehicle driven by an engine and supported by fixed wings
senses.definitionCN: 由发动机驱动、靠固定机翼支撑的飞行器
senses.example: The airplane waited at the gate while the crew checked the wings.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机停在登机口，机组人员在检查机翼。
senses.why: The French coinage named a machine that stays up by its own wings rather than by gas, and that is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个法语新造词指靠自身机翼而非气体升空的机器，这正是它的核心义。

senses.title: A heavier-than-air flying machine
senses.definition: the older technical sense: any flying machine heavier than the air it displaces
senses.definitionCN: 较早的技术义：任何重于它所排开的空气的飞行机器
senses.example: Early writers grouped balloons and airplanes as two very different machines.
senses.exampleCN: 早期作者把气球与重于空气的飞行器视为两类很不一样的机器。
senses.why: When the word was coined, the important question was whether the machine was lighter or heavier than air.
senses.whyCN: 这个词被造出来时，关键问题正是机器比空气更轻还是更重。

senses.title: Any aircraft in loose speech
senses.definition: a loose everyday use for any aircraft, including helicopters in casual talk
senses.definitionCN: 日常口语中泛指任何航空器，闲聊时也包括直升机
senses.example: He has never flown an airplane of any kind.
senses.exampleCN: 他从没驾驶过任何种类的飞行器。
senses.why: Everyday speech often lets one familiar member of a category stand for the whole category.
senses.whyCN: 日常口语常用一个熟悉的成员代表整个类别。

intro.en: Airplane came through French from Greek elements, and its spelling split between British and American usage.
intro.cn: airplane 经法语来自希腊语成分，拼写在英式与美式用法中出现了分化。

items.en: Planos meant wandering or roaming, from plane, a wandering; it gives the -plane element.
items.cn: 希腊语 planos 意为「游荡的、漫游的」，源自 planē「游荡」，提供 -plane 这一成分。

items.en: French coined aéroplane in the nineteenth century for a machine that flies by means of wings rather than by a balloon.
items.cn: 法语在十九世纪造出 aéroplane，指靠机翼而非气球飞行的机器。

items.en: English borrowed aeroplane late in the nineteenth century and used it for heavier-than-air machines.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪后期借入 aeroplane，用来指重于空气的飞行器。

items.en: The simplified spelling airplane spread in the United States in the early twentieth century. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 简化的拼写 airplane 在二十世纪初于美国流行。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Airplane is standard in American English, aeroplane in British English, and both mean the powered fixed-wing machine.
items.cn: airplane 是美式标准写法，aeroplane 是英式写法，两者都指动力固定翼飞机。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the air element or is the same word in another spelling; the near-meaning group gathers flying machines by type.
note.cn: 形近组共享 air 这一成分，或是同一个词的另一种拼写；近义组按类型收各类飞行器。

entries.definition: The British spelling of the same word, with the same meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，是同一个词的英式拼写，含义相同。

entries.definition: The wider term for any flying machine, of which an airplane is one kind.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航空器」，是范围更宽的总称，飞机是其中一类。

entries.definition: A company that operates airplanes; it shares air but names a business.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航空公司」，共享 air 但指企业而非机器。

entries.definition: The short everyday word for an airplane.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，是日常最简短的说法。

entries.definition: An airplane driven by jet engines rather than propellers.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「喷气式飞机」，指由喷气发动机而非螺旋桨驱动的飞机。

entries.definition: A large airplane built to carry many passengers on scheduled flights.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大型客机」，指为定期航线载运大量旅客而造的大飞机。

entries.definition: A flying machine with wings but no engine, which contrasts with the powered airplane.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「滑翔机」，有机翼但没有发动机，正好与动力飞机相对。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek wing element and the phrases airplane appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用希腊语「机翼」成分，以及 airplane 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Planos means wandering, so an airplane is literally a wanderer in the air.
normal.cn: planos 意为「漫游的」，所以 airplane 字面上就是空中的漫游者。

normal.en: Airplane is the American spelling and aeroplane the British one: same machine, one letter fewer.
normal.cn: airplane 是美式拼写，aeroplane 是英式拼写：同一台机器，少了一个字母。

normal.en: Airplane mode turns a phone into something that cannot transmit, as if the phone were on a plane.
normal.cn: airplane mode 让手机不能发射信号，仿佛手机正在飞机上。

normal.en: A paper airplane flies for a second with no engine at all.
normal.cn: 纸飞机完全没有发动机，只飞一秒钟。

normal.en: A glider has the wings of an airplane and none of its engine.
normal.cn: 滑翔机有飞机的机翼，却没有它的发动机。

abstract.en: Picture two fixed wings holding a body up on moving air.
abstract.cn: 想象一对固定的机翼，把机身托在流动的空气上。

abstract.en: Everything else about the machine is detail: the wings are the whole idea.
abstract.cn: 这台机器的其他部分都是细节：机翼才是全部的道理。

abstract.en: Remove the engine and the wings still work; remove the wings and nothing flies.
abstract.cn: 去掉发动机，机翼照样起作用；去掉机翼，什么也飞不起来。

examples.en: The airplane waited at the gate while the crew checked the wings.
examples.cn: 飞机停在登机口，机组人员在检查机翼。

examples.en: He has never flown an airplane of any kind.
examples.cn: 他从没驾驶过任何种类的飞行器。

examples.en: Early writers grouped balloons and airplanes as two very different machines.
examples.cn: 早期作者把气球与重于空气的飞行器视为两类很不一样的机器。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔，普雷恩」——在空中漫游的翼：飞机

root: 希腊语 planos「漫游的」（源自 planē「游荡」）经法语 aéroplane 进入英语为 aeroplane，十九世纪指重于空气、靠机翼飞行的机器；二十世纪初美式拼写简化为 airplane，英式仍作 aeroplane。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses narrow and widen the same machine: the powered fixed-wing plane, the older technical class of heavier-than-air craft, and the loose everyday use for any aircraft.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项围绕同一台机器一收一放：动力固定翼飞机、较早技术分类中的「重于空气的飞行器」，以及口语里泛指任何航空器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two fixed wings hold a body up on moving air.
core.cn: 核心意象：一对固定的机翼，把机身托在流动的空气上。

branches.en: THE WINGS: the fixed wing is the feature that defines the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 机翼线：固定机翼是日常义赖以成立的特征。

branches.en: THE WEIGHT: early aviation classified machines by whether they were lighter or heavier than air.
branches.cn: 重量线：早期航空按机器比空气更轻还是更重来分类。

branches.en: THE CATEGORY: casual speech lets the airplane stand for every flying machine.
branches.cn: 类别线：口语让飞机代表所有飞行机器。

branches.en: THE SPELLING: airplane and aeroplane are one word, differing only by region.
branches.cn: 拼写线：airplane 与 aeroplane 是同一个词，差别只在地域。

branches.en: THE ENGINE: power took the machine from a technical class into daily transport.
branches.cn: 发动机线：动力把这台机器从技术分类带进了日常交通。

intro.en: Airplane is a compound of air and the French-Greek element -plane, with English building compounds on top.
intro.cn: airplane 由 air 与法语—希腊语成分 -plane 构成，英语再在其上构造复合词。

latinIntro.en: The plane element is Greek, not Latin, so the Latin entries remain empty.
latinIntro.cn: plane 这一成分来自希腊语而非拉丁语，因此拉丁条目留空。

items.example: The machine travels through the air.
It supplies the plane element.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 plane 这一成分。

items.example: English borrowed it with little change.
It also appears in monoplane and biplane.
items.exampleCN: 它也出现在 monoplane 与 biplane 中。

items.meaning: a phone setting that disables transmission
items.example: She switched the phone to airplane mode.
items.exampleCN: 她把手机调成了飞行模式。

items.meaning: a small model of a plane
items.example: He built a model airplane from balsa wood.
items.exampleCN: 他用轻木做了一架飞机模型。

items.meaning: a folded paper toy that glides
items.example: The class made paper airplanes after lunch.
items.exampleCN: 午饭后全班折起了纸飞机。

items.example: She booked an airplane ticket online.
