definition_en: a place where aircraft take off and land, with buildings and services for passengers
core_image: 跑道像一条伸进天空的路，尽头接着航站楼
scene: 候机大厅里，广播一遍遍念着登机口变更的消息。Snow closed the airport for most of the morning.
sceneCN: 这里 airport 是「机场」（第 1 个义项：供飞机起降、并配有客运设施的场所）；句意为大雪让机场关闭了大半个上午。

pos.zh: 名词：机场；航空港

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 terminal 构成的复合词，义为「航站楼」
由本词加 tax 构成的复合词，义为「机场税」

senses.title: A place where aircraft take off and land
senses.definition: an area with runways and buildings where aircraft take off, land, and load passengers or cargo
senses.definitionCN: 设有跑道与建筑、供航空器起降、上下旅客或装卸货物的场区
senses.example: Snow closed the airport for most of the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 大雪让机场关闭了大半个上午。
senses.why: Port in the old sense is a harbour, a place where vessels call; aircraft call at an airport in the same way.
senses.whyCN: port 的古义是港口，即船只停靠之处；航空器以同样的方式在这类地方停靠。

senses.title: A large international hub
senses.definition: a major airport with terminals, customs, and long-haul services between countries
senses.definitionCN: 设有航站楼与海关、运营跨国长途航线的大型机场
senses.example: The new airport can handle two hundred flights a day.
senses.exampleCN: 新航空港每天能处理两百个航班。
senses.why: As air travel grew, the word scaled up to the huge hubs that serve whole regions.
senses.whyCN: 随着航空旅行发展，这个词放大到服务整个区域的大型枢纽。

senses.title: A military airfield
senses.definition: a base where military aircraft are kept, serviced, and launched
senses.definitionCN: 停放、维护并出动军用航空器的基地
senses.example: The old airport is now used mainly by military aircraft.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧机场如今主要供军用航空器使用。
senses.why: Flying machines need the same ground facilities whether the users wear uniforms or not.
senses.whyCN: 无论使用者是否穿军装，飞行机器都需要同样的地面设施。

senses.title: The organisation running the site
senses.definition: the company or authority that operates an airport, often named in news reports
senses.definitionCN: 运营机场的公司或管理机构，新闻中常以此指代
senses.example: The airport said the runway would reopen at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 机场方面表示跑道将在中午重新开放。
senses.why: A place can stand for the body that runs it, a common shift from site to institution.
senses.whyCN: 场所可以代表管理它的机构，这是从场地到机构的常见转移。

intro.en: Airport borrows the old word port, meaning harbour, and applies it to places where aircraft call.
intro.cn: airport 借用了意为「港口」的古词 port，把它用到航空器停靠的地方。

items.en: Portus meant a harbour or a haven, a sheltered place where ships could stop.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portus 意为「港口、避风处」，指船只可以停靠的有遮蔽之处。

items.en: Port entered English through French with the sense of a harbour or a town with a harbour.
items.cn: port 经法语进入英语，指港口或拥有港口的城镇。

items.en: Air plus port was applied to places where aircraft, and at first airships, could land and be served. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: air 加 port 被用来指航空器（起初是飞艇）可以降落并得到服务的地方。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: With mass air travel the word settled on the modern site with runways, terminals, and customs.
items.cn: 随着大众航空旅行，这个词固定指拥有跑道、航站楼与海关的现代场所。

items.en: The word also stands for the authority that runs the site, as in statements issued by the airport.
items.cn: 这个词也代表运营场地的管理机构，如机场方面发布的声明。

note.en: The look-alike group is built from airport; the near-meaning group gathers other words for places where aircraft operate.
note.cn: 形近组由 airport 构成；近义组收其他表示航空器作业场所的词。

entries.definition: The building where passengers check in and board, part of an airport.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航站楼」，指旅客办理手续与登机的那座建筑，是机场的一部分。

entries.definition: A charge added to tickets to pay for airport facilities.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「机场税」，指加在机票上、用于支付机场设施的费用。

entries.definition: An area of open ground for aircraft, often without the full buildings of an airport.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞行场」，指供航空器使用的开阔场地，往往没有机场那样完整的建筑。

entries.definition: A formal or older word for an area where aircraft take off and land.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「机场、飞行场」，是较正式或较早的说法。

entries.definition: The passenger building at an airport or station, only one part of the whole.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航站楼、终点站」，只是整个机场或车站的一部分。

entries.definition: A small site for helicopters, built on the model of airport.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「直升机起降场」，是仿照 airport 构成的较小场地。

entries.definition: The long strip aircraft use for taking off and landing, inside an airport.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「跑道」，指机场内供航空器起降的长条地面。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the harbour origin of port and the phrases airport appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用 port 的「港口」来源，以及 airport 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Port means harbour, and an airport is a harbour for aircraft instead of ships.
normal.cn: port 意为港口，airport 就是给航空器而非船只用的港口。

normal.en: International airport handles the same idea at a national border, with customs attached.
normal.cn: international airport 把同一个概念放到国境上，并配上海关。

normal.en: Airport terminal is only one building of the whole site, not the site itself.
normal.cn: airport terminal 只是整个场地中的一座建筑，而不是场地本身。

normal.en: Heliport copies airport and swaps the first element for helicopters.
normal.cn: heliport 仿照 airport 构成，把前半换成直升机。

normal.en: The airport said is a place speaking as an institution.
normal.cn: The airport said 是场所像一个机构那样开口说话。

abstract.en: Picture a runway as a road that leaves the ground and ends in the sky.
abstract.cn: 想象跑道是一条离开地面、通向天空的路。

abstract.en: At the near end of that road stand buildings, queues, and a customs desk.
abstract.cn: 这条路的近端立着建筑、排着队，还有一张海关桌。

abstract.en: The whole arrangement is a harbour, only the vessels arrive from above.
abstract.cn: 整套安排就是一个港口，只是船是从上方来的。

examples.en: Snow closed the airport for most of the morning.
examples.cn: 大雪让机场关闭了大半个上午。

examples.en: The new airport can handle two hundred flights a day.
examples.cn: 新航空港每天能处理两百个航班。

examples.en: The airport said the runway would reopen at noon.
examples.cn: 机场方面表示跑道将在中午重新开放。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔，坡特」——空中的港口，飞机在此靠岸：机场

root: 英语 air 与 port 的复合。port 出自拉丁语 portus「港口」，经法语进入英语；二十世纪初 air 加 port 用来指航空器（起初为飞艇）可停靠之处，二十世纪中期固定指拥有跑道、航站楼与海关的现代机场，并引申指运营该场地的机构。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses move around one harbour idea: the ordinary site, the giant international hub, the military base, and the authority that speaks for the place.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项围绕同一个「港口」观念：普通机场、大型国际枢纽、军用基地，以及替这个场所发声的管理方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a runway leaves the ground like a road and ends in the sky.
core.cn: 核心意象：跑道像一条路离开地面，尽头接向天空。

branches.en: THE SITE: the ordinary sense names the ground where aircraft call and are served.
branches.cn: 场地线：普通义指航空器停靠并得到服务的地面。

branches.en: THE HUB: scale the site up to a region and add customs and long-haul routes.
branches.cn: 枢纽线：把场地放大到一个区域，再加上海关与长途航线。

branches.en: THE BASE: the same facilities serve aircraft flown by armed forces.
branches.cn: 基地线：同样的设施也供武装部队的航空器使用。

branches.en: THE VOICE: the place stands for the organisation that runs it.
branches.cn: 发声线：场所代表运营它的机构。

branches.en: THE PORT: both rest on the old harbour sense, a sheltered place where vessels stop.
branches.cn: 港口线：两者都建立在古老的港口义上，即船只停靠的有遮蔽之处。

intro.en: Airport is a native compound of air and the borrowed word port, and English builds further compounds on it.
intro.cn: airport 由 air 与借入词 port 构成的复合词，英语在它之上继续构造复合词。

latinIntro.en: Portus is recorded Latin, so the port element is attested rather than reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: portus 是有记录的拉丁词，port 这一成分属于有据可查而非重构。

items.example: Aircraft arrive through the air.
Portus is the source of port.
items.exampleCN: portus 是 port 的来源。

items.meaning: a harbour or a town with one
items.example: The second half means a harbour.
It forms airport terminal.
It forms airport tax.

items.meaning: an airport for flights between countries
items.example: The international airport opened a new terminal.
items.exampleCN: 国际机场启用了新航站楼。

items.example: Heliport copies the pattern of airport.
items.exampleCN: heliport 仿照 airport 的模式构成。

items.example: Airport security opened another lane.
items.exampleCN: 机场安检又开了一条通道。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 terminal 构成的复合词，义为「航站楼」
由本词加 tax 构成的复合词，义为「机场税」
